cache_protocol: Common compiled fixture and corpus are copied into isolated arm workspaces; shared preparation wall time is charged to every arm.
adaptive_rule: Start with one-call plans; promote after a complete no-model/no-candidate or all-paths-reverted result, or after exhaustion when every one-call feedback is complete no-progress/candidate-rejected. Timeout, unsupported, and tool errors alone do not trigger promotion. Stop on confirmation or when query plus native reserve cannot fit.
residual_randomness: Medusa corpus and mutation chooser RNG is clock seeded after the common warmup.
